title: Estonia's Cost-of-Living Crisis Reshapes Political Landscape Ahead of Next… · 10 Oct
keywords: Estonia, inflation, cost of living, fuel prices, diesel, gasoline, Center Party, Isamaa, Estonian politics, fiscal policy, energy costs, Baltic states, EU economy, election polling, defence spending
notes: A sharp acceleration in inflation, driven by fuel and housing costs, is squeezing Estonian households and intensifying pressure on the governing coalition. With the opposition Center Party surging in at least one recent poll, the country's next election is shaping up as an economic referendum. The tension between fiscal discipline, rising defense needs, and household relief is now at the centre of Estonian political debate.
